steps.sql: SELECT customer_region, destination_region, MEASURE(count) c FROM two_paths GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

steps.note: the same data through join alias

steps.sql: SELECT customer_region, destination_region, MEASURE(count) c FROM two_aliases GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

steps.truth: SELECT r1.region AS customer_region, r2.region AS destination_region, count(*) AS c FROM repro.orders o JOIN repro.users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN repro.regions r1 ON u.state = r1.state JOIN repro.shipments s ON o.id = s.order_id JOIN repro.regions r2 ON s.state = r2.state GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
